definitions.gloss: tight-lipped, discreet, able to keep secrets
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who can be trusted with confidential information and won't reveal it to others.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{口|くち}が{堅|かた}いから、{何|なん}でも{相談|そうだん}できる。
examples.english: She's discreet, so I can consult her about anything.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}の{堅|かた}い{人|ひと}にしか{話|はな}せない。
examples.english: I can only tell this to someone who can keep a secret.

examples.japanese: {秘書|ひしょ}は{口|くち}が{堅|かた}くなければならない。

notes:
STRUCTURE: {口|くち} (mouth) + が + {堅|かた}い (hard/firm). Literally 'one's mouth is firm' - implying words don't escape easily.

ANTONYM: {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い (loose-lipped, indiscreet)

PRENOMINAL FORM: {口|くち}の{堅|かた}い + noun (a discreet [person])

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {秘密|ひみつ}を{守|まも}る (to keep a secret)
- {信頼|しんらい}できる (trustworthy)

CULTURAL NOTE: Being {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い is considered a valuable trait in Japanese business and personal relationships.
